data.body: Implementation pushed: Gerrit change 1297 (commit defacafc6d). Registry src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_field_contract.py (176 LOC): 11 fields declared across bidirectional/add_wins/one_way_gated; conflict_class mirrors conflict_resolver.FIELD_CLASSES; links/parent name should_propagate_removal as removal gate; status declares lossy_values={blocked,cancelled,deleted}. Property tests tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_field_contract_properties.py (16 tests, all green): import-time coverage guard (FIELD_CLASSES + _OUTBOUND_TO_INBOUND_FIELD -> collection failure on undeclared field), conflict-class parity, status roundtrip on canonical preimages + computed-residue==declared-lossy (both directions), link_direction involution + resolve_inbound_link, reducer TAG_DELTA add-wins (in-both stays added, replay idempotent, plain remove applies), gate managed/unmanaged/malformed. docs/architecture.md registration-contract paragraph added. Mutation checks per plan verified: flip labels class -> test_core_field_classes_pinned FAILS by name; delete watchers entry -> collection ERROR; restored -> 16 pass. Full reconciler unit suite: 2033 passed, 1 pre-existing env-dependent failure (test_ref_lock roundtrip, fails on stashed clean tree too — unrelated). Lint/format/mypy green. Note: today's main landed 6baa030460 + revert 2241e3d189 (inbound parent clear destroyed data) — a live instance of exactly the asymmetry class this registry pins (parent is one_way_gated; removal only via managed-ref gate).
